short_description: Older digital dome laser system ('Laser for Dome' in 143190). Lower brightness and spec than the current GT-class 'Dome with Laser.' Exact hardware identity uncertain — used at institutional OMNIMAX venues.

default_projection.effective_resolution_label: 4K digital laser dome projection with fisheye/anamorphic optics; pre-2018 generation.
default_projection.contrast_notes: No published specs for this system. Exact hardware identity is uncertain (143190 tag 'Laser for Dome' may refer to an earlier-generation laser or a transitional xenon/laser hybrid). Brightness is a conservative community estimate vs. the GT-class Dome with Laser (~22 fL). Keep null for contrast until confirmed.

known_limitations: No 3D capability — single-projector dome laser system; no dual-projector configuration exists
Older-generation dome laser system — lower brightness (~14 fL community estimate) vs. current 'Dome with Laser' GT-class system (~22 fL)
Exact hardware identity uncertain per research; no published spec sheet — brightness and contrast are community estimates
Not a conventional cinema — requires dome-mastered content; standard flat IMAX films appear distorted through dome optics
Institutional venues only; not part of commercial multiplex IMAX network
Effective brightness per unit area varies with dome diameter — larger domes receive fewer lumens per square foot
